notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.chumbak.com/robots.txt) has User-agent:* Disallow list of only checkout/cart/search/account/policy paths - no blanket block, and explicit 'User-agent: anthropic-ai / Allow: /'. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) worked for every page - homepage, /pages/furniture, /collections/home-and-living, /collections.json, sitemap.xml and every collection page returned full server-rendered HTML with real product counts and JSON-LD; no client hydration or block encountered, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built the union of (1) the 'Home & Decor' desktop mega-menu on the homepage (groups: Dining, Decor & Living, Furniture & Furnishing, Vintage Chumbak), (2) the /pages/furniture landing page's own category-card grid (Wing Chairs, Sofas, French Rattan, Colonial Couch, Pouffes, Storage, Ottomans, Benches, Stools, etc.), (3) the site's collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 553 handles) and /collections.json (554 published collections) as a cross-check, and (4) each qualifying category page's own outbound links (none exposed additional sub-category strips beyond the ones already in nav). Chumbak is Shopify-based; every candidate node's h1/canonical was confirmed to match the requested handle before recording. QTY: taken verbatim from the rendered 'collection-toolbar__products-count' header text on each collection page (e.g. '117 products'); empty collections used the page's own 'This collection is empty' state. No number was estimated, paginated-and-counted, or inferred. EXCLUDED and why: this is a quirky gifting/lifestyle brand - the overwhelming majority of the catalog (Dining & Drinkware, Serving & Tableware, Bakeware, Coffee Mugs, Table & Wall Decor, Planters, Candles, Furniture such as Sofas/Pouffes/Breakfast Tables/Wing Chairs, Vintage Chumbak novelty items, Bags & Travel, Watches, Gift Store) is Kitchen & Dining / Wall Decor / Decorative Accessories / Furniture / apparel-travel-accessory, none of which are Textile or Storage per the two rule files' boundary sections, so it was skipped. /collections/trunks-suitcases ('Trunks & Storage', 57 products, linked from the Decor & Living menu) was inspected product-by-product: it is dominated by decorative serving/trinket trays and tissue boxes (Florentine Hound Wooden Tray, Bloom Trinket Tray, Roar Tray Trail Set, Tropical Toucan Trinket Box, Jaipur Gardens Kasuti Tray, tissue boxes, etc.) with only a handful of genuine Storage Boxes/Trunks mixed in - primary product type of this node is Decorative Home Accessories per storage.md Sec.24, so it was excluded rather than force-classified as Storage. 'Travel Pillows' and 'Scarves' under the Bags & Travel menu were excluded as personal travel/apparel items, not home textile (textile.md Sec.19). A large number of additional storage/textile-sounding collection handles exist in the XML sitemap and collections.json but are NOT reachable from any current navigation path checked above (e.g. storage-boxes, storage-containers, storage-jars-and-trunks, storage-jars-boxes, storage-tins, jars-boxes, baskets-carriers, boxes-trunks, bed-linen, bedsheets, bedsheets-comforters, quilts-dohars, throws-quilts, table-linen, table-runner-mats, floor-rugs, bath-rugs, fabric, fabrics, furnishing-cushion, cushions-furniture, floor-seat-cushions, spring-time-cushions) - these were spot-checked and appear to be orphaned/legacy collections not part of the live category tree (two spot-checked handles, storage-shelving and baskets, are explicitly empty), so per 'follow the actual website navigation' (textile.md Sec.24 / storage.md Sec.33) they were not fabricated into rows. Two judgment calls flagged LOW/MEDIUM: (1) /collections/storage ('Storage', 20 products, all 'Storage/Trunk Ottoman' items) is furniture-storage hybrid seating; it is explicitly presented as its own distinct tile on the Furniture landing page separate from the 'Ottomans' and 'Pouffes' tiles, so per storage.md Sec.21 (explicit site categorization) it was recorded as Storage with confidence MEDIUM - recommend cross-checking against the Furniture extraction for this company to avoid double counting. (2) /collections/bed-furnishing (nav label 'Bed Linen', h1 'Bed & Furnishings', 129 products) turned out on inspection to be almost entirely cushion covers/shape cushions (not bedding/sheets), overlapping heavily with the separate /collections/cushion-covers (117 products) node; both are genuinely distinct live URLs with different counts so both were kept per the duplicate rule, but bed-furnishing is flagged MEDIUM confidence given the nav-label/content mismatch.
